pass_rule: 30/25/25/20 compared against approved diagnostic alternatives; large unstable result changes trigger review before freeze.
interpretation_rule: Weight sensitivity is diagnostic. Synthetic score drift or pairwise reversal proves the detector works; it does not prove that real Pilot 20 results are unstable or choose a preferred weighting.
blockers_to_start: No frozen Pilot 20 reconciled score corpus exists.
G03/G04 real scoring and reconciliation have not occurred.
No real score-drift or pairwise-stability report exists.
No human decision defines what degree of instability requires methodology revision.
human_gate: Software may flag drift and reversals but may not choose weights, optimise for preferred institutions, or mark G06 passed.
